Title: TOM: Errata for discipline (and card) balance needed.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
I'm sure this has come up already, but I haven't seen it in the design team
rulings, so:

There are an equal number of commons in each discipline, except
Fortitude - which has one extra, and
Thaumaturgy - which has one less, and
Obfuscate - which has one extra.

Blood Rage - an obvious Th effect is marked as Fo
It is the same as Blood Fury (Th), except it doesn't cost
a blood, and deals one less damage.
Isn't this the "missing" Th?

Concealed Weapon - an Obfuscate effect with no superior
effect listed, which does the same thing as Disguised
Weapon (Ob), but with a pair of restrictions making
it vastly inferior to the Disguised Weapon.
Isn't this supposed to be a normal (no discipline-needed)
card?

This would make the disciplines equal in number of commons (which
I hope was the plan) and make Concealed weapon a worthwhile card.

Thanks
L. Scott
